inclusion_rule: Lip-reading or VSR studies whose ledger names optical-camera input and the GRID corpus, classified by the evaluation partition their full text names: an unseen-speaker (speaker-independent or held-out speaker) split, an overlapped-speaker (seen-speaker or speaker-dependent) split, or explicit reuse of the held-out speakers 1, 2, 20 and 22. A separate regex counts studies that report a standard deviation, a confidence interval or a significance test. Boundary: audio-only GRID work and GRID studies without a recognition or synthesis decoder are excluded; a study counts under every partition its text names (upper bound); versions count once by key.
